Method of Attack: Bypassing sandbox restrictions on 'rl_safe_eval' to execute arbitrary Python code
Using the built-in 'type' function to create malicious classes and functions
Executing arbitrary OS commands via constructed bytecode functions
Impacted Systems: Software using ReportLab Toolkit for PDF generation from HTML input
Attack Vector: Incorporation of malicious code in HTML files converted to PDF using ReportLab
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit published on GitHub for CVE-2023-33733
